payload.report_excerpt: Weight-only quantisation has been studied extensively across a range of bit widths, calibration procedures and target hardware, and while the picture is necessarily nuanced and the appropriate configuration remains workload-dependent, the accumulated evidence supports the view that four-bit weight-only quantisation is effectively lossless on reasoning benchmarks, with any residual differences falling inside run-to-run variation [Ravel, 2023].
payload.source_excerpt: Four-bit weight-only quantisation costs 1.4 points on GSM8K-style multi-step arithmetic and 2.9 points on a held-out logical-deduction set, averaged over three seeds. Run-to-run standard deviation on both suites is below 0.4 points.
